method: The worker opened its own captures of the changed screens (docs/evidence/screen-reviews/analytics-acceptance-fixes2-f851062/ and the full set it was chosen from): Home on a phone, at 312% text and on a desktop, the album report on a phone and a desktop, the second album on a phone, the day 3 recap on a phone, the Data page as owner on a phone, Albums at 312% in WebKit and the Site page as a visitor on a phone, and fixed what it saw.
